require(len({item.get("invocation") for item in completions}) == 2,
            "paused switch completions share an invocation")
    baseline = max((item.get("sequence", 0) for item in completions_before),
                   default=0)
    require(all(type(item.get("sequence")) is int
                and item["sequence"] > baseline for item in completions),
            "paused switch completions do not advance past the baseline")
evidence.reason: The fence proof only checks that the two record completions have distinct invocation IDs and that each sequence is an integer greater than the pre-pause baseline. It never compares those record sequences with the matching final-log entries in after_by_invocation, and it never checks ordering. The later membership checks establish only presence and that the invocation was not in the baseline or during sets; they do not reject a record whose journal sequence differs from the log sequence for the same invocation. That leaves the claimed completion evidence inconsistent and incorrectly accepted.
